text: AI Platform: software platforms for artificial intelligence, including machine learning operations (MLOps) tools, generative AI frameworks, and enterprise AI integration services; AI platform; artificial intelligence platform; AI software; machine learning platform; MLOps; generative AI; AI framework; AI solution; AI services
